title: Google Gives You 1.5 Million Free AI Tokens Daily
description:
Google AI Studio gives you roughly 1.5 million tokens a day across Gemini 2.5 Flash and 1.5 Pro - free, with just a Google account. The catch: 10-30 requests per minute, and Pro models are paid-only on the API since April. #Shorts #ai #aitools
